customer_name: Cloud Expo Co., Ltd. (云上会展有限公司)
business_problem: Cloud Expo had to keep exhibition information current across many complex projects while handling large volumes of attendee and exhibitor questions. Manual Q&A maintenance and human service queues were costly and slow, and the company needed a way to turn event documents and FAQs into always-on support inside its digital exhibition platform.
solution_summary: Cloud Expo embedded Alibaba Cloud's Tongyi intelligent dialogue robot into its exhibition-service stack so visitor support could move from manual FAQ maintenance to always-on conversational service. The company already runs event platforms, digital marketing tools, and data-driven exhibition services across many projects, so the implementation is designed around fast updates to changing schedules, venue information, and project content. The dialogue robot is integrated directly into mini programs, where exhibitors and attendees can tap into a chat experience instead of waiting for staff to respond. Behind the interface, organizers can upload event documents and FAQ material to create a project-specific knowledge base that answers schedule, venue, and exhibition questions with lower operating cost than traditional manual maintenance. Feedback from those conversations can then be used to refine personalization and future planning across the broader exhibition platform.
products_used: event document and FAQ knowledge base

solution_components.name: Tongyi intelligent dialogue robot
solution_components.role: Handles conversational event support for attendees and exhibitors across exhibition projects.

solution_components.name: mini program integration
solution_components.role: Embeds the dialogue robot directly into the mobile event experience so users can invoke support on demand.

solution_components.name: event document and FAQ knowledge base
solution_components.role: Stores schedules, venue details, and project-specific content that the dialogue robot can retrieve and answer from.

data_flow: Event documents, schedules, location data, and FAQ content are uploaded into a project-specific knowledge base. The Tongyi dialogue robot retrieves from that content when users ask questions inside the mini program, then returns answers and collects interaction data that can be used to refine future exhibition support and planning.
business_outcome: Cloud Expo turned exhibition consulting into a low-cost, self-service support layer that scales across diverse projects. The chatbot improves participant experience with instant answers, reduces the operating load on service teams, and gives the company a reusable support module that can be rolled out quickly across more than 40 major digital exhibition projects.
architecture_clues: The dialogue robot is embedded directly into exhibition mini programs instead of being limited to a separate help site.
Organizers can bootstrap support by uploading documents and FAQs rather than hand-authoring every response path.
The same conversational layer is expected to feed back user-demand signals for future personalization and planning.
